verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a commerce/billing platform with an API, but the evidence never documents any bulk or batch capability. The API, webhooks and the coupon management view are general or adjacent features. The community suggestion to export customers via the API is a user-side workaround, not a product bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
